notes: EBIT definition: Pfizer’s filings in this package do not present a line explicitly labeled 'Operating income'. For DCF input purposes, historical 'ebit' is set to 'Income from continuing operations before provision/(benefit) for taxes on income' (includes net other income/deductions and restructuring items; excludes discontinued operations). ([s206.q4cdn.com](https://s206.q4cdn.com/795948973/files/doc_financials/2025/q4/2025-Form-10-K.pdf))

D&A definition: uses 'Depreciation and amortization' from the consolidated cash flow statement (absolute value). ([s206.q4cdn.com](https://s206.q4cdn.com/795948973/files/doc_financials/2025/q4/2025-Form-10-K.pdf))

Capex definition: uses 'Purchases of property, plant and equipment' from the consolidated cash flow statement (reported as an outflow; modeled here as absolute value). ([s206.q4cdn.com](https://s206.q4cdn.com/795948973/files/doc_financials/2025/q4/2025-Form-10-K.pdf))

NWC construction (level, not change): NWC = (Total current assets − Cash and cash equivalents − Short-term investments) − (Total current liabilities − Short-term borrowings, incl. current portion of long-term debt). Values for 2025/2024 from the FY2025 balance sheet and for 2023 from the FY2023 balance sheet. ([s206.q4cdn.com](https://s206.q4cdn.com/795948973/files/doc_financials/2025/q4/2025-Form-10-K.pdf))

Tax rate: base-case tax_rate = 0.15 using Pfizer’s stated effective tax rate on adjusted income for FY2026 (~15.0%). ([s206.q4cdn.com](https://s206.q4cdn.com/795948973/files/doc_financials/2025/q4/Q4-2025-PFE-Earnings-Release-FINAL2.pdf))

NOL balance: null because FY2025 10-K disclosures provided net deferred tax asset components related to 'net operating loss/tax credit carryforwards' rather than a single explicit NOL principal balance suitable for cash tax shield modeling. NOL utilization percent is set to 0.80 as a placeholder assumption. ([s206.q4cdn.com](https://s206.q4cdn.com/795948973/files/doc_financials/2025/q4/2025-Form-10-K.pdf))

Comps: MarketScreener provides 'P/E (Y)', 'EV / Sales (Y)', and 'EV / EBITDA (Y)' estimates; these are treated as NTM/next-year proxies (not strictly defined as NTM Revenue/EBITDA in the source table). ([marketscreener.com](https://www.marketscreener.com/quote/stock/GSK-PLC-9590199/valuation/))

catalysts: ~20 key pivotal study starts planned for 2026, including obesity-related pivotal trials and PF-08634404 pivotal trials. ([s206.q4cdn.com](https://s206.q4cdn.com/795948973/files/doc_financials/2025/q4/Q4-2025-PFE-Earnings-Release-FINAL2.pdf))

Potential incremental upside from late-stage pipeline data readouts and associated regulatory and commercial milestones during 2026. ([s206.q4cdn.com](https://s206.q4cdn.com/795948973/files/doc_financials/2025/q4/Q4-2025-PFE-Earnings-Release-FINAL2.pdf))
company_overview: Pfizer is a global biopharmaceutical company, with Biopharma as its only reportable segment for commercial operations. ([s206.q4cdn.com](https://s206.q4cdn.com/795948973/files/doc_financials/2025/q4/2025-Form-10-K.pdf))

In FY2025, Pfizer reported total revenues of $62.6 billion and focused on portfolio execution post-COVID transition. ([s206.q4cdn.com](https://s206.q4cdn.com/795948973/files/doc_financials/2025/q4/Q4-2025-PFE-Earnings-Release-FINAL2.pdf))
current_context: FY2025 revenues were $62.6 billion (2% YoY operational decline); non-COVID portfolio revenues grew 6% operationally. ([s206.q4cdn.com](https://s206.q4cdn.com/795948973/files/doc_financials/2025/q4/Q4-2025-PFE-Earnings-Release-FINAL2.pdf))

Pfizer reaffirmed FY2026 guidance with revenues in a range of $59.5 to $62.5 billion and adjusted diluted EPS of $2.80 to $3.00, including an effective tax rate on adjusted income of ~15.0%. ([s206.q4cdn.com](https://s206.q4cdn.com/795948973/files/doc_financials/2025/q4/Q4-2025-PFE-Earnings-Release-FINAL2.pdf))
investment_highlights: Base-case revenue outlook reflects near-term COVID-19 normalization and loss-of-exclusivity headwinds consistent with FY2026 revenue guidance, followed by gradual stabilization. ([s206.q4cdn.com](https://s206.q4cdn.com/795948973/files/doc_financials/2025/q4/Q4-2025-PFE-Earnings-Release-FINAL2.pdf))

EBIT margin is modeled to remain in the low-teens (rising modestly to 12.5% by 2030) to reflect cost-management progress and stable operating margins assumptions in guidance. ([pfizer.com](https://www.pfizer.com/news/press-release/press-release-detail/pfizer-reaffirms-full-year-2025-eps-guidance-and-provides))

Reinvestment intensity uses historical D&A, capex, and working-capital intensity (NWC) to reflect Pfizer’s cash generation and capital allocation requirements. ([s206.q4cdn.com](https://s206.q4cdn.com/795948973/files/doc_financials/2025/q4/2025-Form-10-K.pdf))
Terminal economics use Gordon growth with long-run growth at 2.0% and WACC at 8.5%, consistent with a mature developed-market pharma profile (base-case assumption).
key_risks: Revenue compression risk from ongoing loss of exclusivity and COVID-19 normalization versus expectations. ([pfizer.com](https://www.pfizer.com/news/press-release/press-release-detail/pfizer-reaffirms-full-year-2025-eps-guidance-and-provides))

Pricing and reimbursement pressure risk (e.g., Most-Favored-Nation drug pricing, TrumpRx) and tariff impacts referenced in FY2026 guidance. ([s206.q4cdn.com](https://s206.q4cdn.com/795948973/files/doc_financials/2025/q4/Q4-2025-PFE-Earnings-Release-FINAL2.pdf))
